Project \#6 Make a cool snake\!

For this project, we needed to apply some cool shaders to a snake. I animated my so, just about every part I added was also animated. I created a vorinoi texture based on some code online. Based on this vorinoi texture I colored and displaced the snake. In the vertext shader I also displaced the snake so it would bend in a circle and move up and down with a sine wave. In the vertex shader I used the vorinoi to add rainbow scales, aswell as used the noise texture to add start spots with a smoothstep to fade them out over the snake. Using the noise I also added fire to the top. The noise gets added to the position then clipped so that the fire shrinks insteads of fading out.
